# Sancar Games

> Sancar Games is an independent mobile game studio from Türkiye making puzzle and physics games for iPhone and iPad. Website: https://sancargames.com (Turkish) and https://sancargames.com/en/ (English). Contact: support@sancargames.com

## Games

- [Demolition Master: Tower Blast](https://sancargames.com/en/demolition-master): physics demolition game for iPhone (Turkish name: Yıkım Ustası). Choose the right machine (sledgehammer, breaker, wrecking ball, hydraulic shear, dynamite, C4) for each material and bring buildings down before time runs out. Free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6823286892
- [Number Path](https://sancargames.com/en/number-path): number puzzle for iPhone (Turkish name: Sayı Yolu). Draw one path that visits every cell once and hits the red numbers on exactly that step. Coming soon.
- Lantern Detective (Turkish name: Fenerli Dedektif): detective puzzle game for iPhone where you light dark rooms with a lantern. Coming soon.
